definitions.explanation: A member of the warrior class in feudal Japan. Also used to describe someone with warrior-like qualities.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{武士道|ぶしどう}→武士道：17460_bushidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{武士|ぶし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧だ。
examples.english: Bushido is the spirit of the samurai.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧二⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びていた→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Historical term for the warrior class. ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧ is a synonym but {武士|ぶし} is more formal.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{武士道|ぶしどう}→武士道：17460_bushidou⟧ (bushido, the way of the warrior)
・{武士|ぶし}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧ (samurai class)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{武士|ぶし}は食わねど⟦{高楊枝|たかようじ}→高楊枝：noentry⟧ (A samurai pretends to be full even when hungry - proverb about pride)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧ - samurai (more commonly used internationally)
・⟦{武者|むしゃ}→武者：28922_musha⟧ - warrior (especially in battle)
